agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py's ReindentFilter._split_statements: it was checking truthiness of the `prev_` token object (which remained truthy even after being deleted from tlist.tokens) to decide whether to insert a newline before a DML/DDL keyword, instead of checking the token's actual position. This caused an extra blank line to be inserted between statements when reindenting SQL like 'select foo; select bar'. Changed the condition to `if tidx > 0:` so it correctly checks position rather than the stale object reference. Verified with multiple manual test cases (plain multi-statement SQL, statements separated by newlines, statements with trailing comments, and statements with VALUES clauses) that formatting now produces the expected single blank line between statements without extra or missing whitespace.
